utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the dues are due soon, Eli. I can check what the club decided and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. Let me know once you’ve checked so I can plan for it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check on it and let you know as soon as I hear what they decided.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can cover it if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, I’ll get it covered this time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No worries, I’ve got it this time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the dues are due this month, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I think so - we should probably check the exact due date, just to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but I’d like to confirm the exact date before anyone pays.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the dues. I think I owe mine — can you remind me how much it was again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It was twenty dollars this month.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, twenty dollars makes sense. I’ll bring it by soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to confirm, are you asking me to pay the full dues now or check the amount first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m just asking to check the amount first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it. I’ll check the amount first before paying anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but I can chip in now if you’re collecting dues.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane. Thanks for catching up now; I’ll mark you down as paid.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks — I’m all set now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Gus. Let’s figure out what’s due and get it settled.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Sam. Just tell me the amount due and I’ll get it settled.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I don’t have the amount in front of me yet, but I’m checking on it now so we can get you squared away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check the dues amount and the payment date if you want.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please check both so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check and let you know the dues amount and payment date.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the dues are due this week, and the club treasurer said you can drop them off at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, I’ll drop mine off at the community hall today.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I’ll do mine too so we’re all set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did Rey already collect the club dues this month?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet, I was going to ask around today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. How much are we collecting from each member?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can cover my share soon, Nell, and I’ll mention it to the others too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik. I heard that from you, so I’ll let the others know too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Good, I’ll remind the others again and make sure my dues are sorted soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I can help with the dues. If it works for you, just bring them by this week and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll bring them by this week.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks Uli. I’ll keep an eye out for them this week.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the dues are still due this week, Eli. I can point you to Mara if you need the exact amount.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. Please point me to Mara, and I’ll get the exact amount.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing, Eli — Mara’s around by the bulletin board if you want to ask her directly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what do I owe for the dues?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s twenty bucks for the month. I can keep your spot if you hand it over tonight.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll bring the twenty tonight.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure about the dues yet. Could you tell me how much they are and when they’re due?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: They’re twenty dollars, due by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, I’ll bring twenty dollars by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, just tell me the amount and I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s $20 for the month. I can put your name on the list once it’s paid.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll pay it now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I can help sort that out if you want to go over the dues together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. Could we go through the dues together step by step so I can make sure I understand them correctly?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course, we can go through each line together and I’ll keep it simple step by step.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the dues. I think I still need to pay mine too - how much was it again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It was $20 this month. Just bring it by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I’ll drop off the $20 soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can ask around after I finish my errands and let you know what I hear about the dues.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate you checking around.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem, Gus. I’ll ask around and let you know what I find after my errands.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Leo. I can help sort out the dues if you want to go over them together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, let’s go through them together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, let’s take a look at the dues together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Do we know when the dues are due? I want to make sure I bring the right amount.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I think they’re due at the start of next month, but I’ll check to be sure. Bring the usual amount for now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, I’ll bring the usual amount unless you hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can ask around and see if anyone wants to chip in for the dues.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That helps. Just let me know what people say, and I’ll keep track of who owes what.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll ask around and pass along what I find.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take care of the dues after school pickup, but what’s the amount and when do you need it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think it’s around twenty dollars, and tomorrow would be great if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me, I’ll bring twenty dollars tomorrow after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Nell, I can help with that. If dues are the issue, we can sort out a payment plan that works.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa. A payment plan would help a lot, so maybe we can work out something manageable.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, we can set one up that’s manageable and steady for you.
